author: nemi

author: nemi
text: Between the noodles and dumplings, the shots kept multiplying. ADB was sitting there looking calm while the rest of us were slowly ascending to another dimension.

author: nemi
text: And that is when someone brought out Pictionary. If you've never played Pictionary while completely blasted... do not do it.

identity_prompt: Warm, natural young adult woman around 24, relaxed conversational speech, friendly, casual, intelligent, slightly playful.

author: nemi

author: nemi

author: nemi

author: nemi
